one_sentence: The Genesis lifespan data fits an exponential decay curve with an asymptotic floor at ~93 years, which Psalm 90 and modern life expectancy independently confirm as a grace-maintained minimum Logos-coupling.
executive_summary: This document argues that the lifespan data in Genesis 5 and 11, when plotted against generation number, follows an exponential decay curve with high precision (R² = 0.888). The curve reveals an asymptotic floor at approximately 93 years, which the model found without constraint. This floor aligns with Psalm 90:10's 'threescore years and ten' (70–80 years) and modern global life expectancy (~73 years), suggesting three independent measurements of the same physical reality. The document interprets this as evidence for 'generational entropy'—compounding misalignment with the Logos inherited across generations—and posits that the χ vacuum field (common grace) maintains a minimum coherence that prevents lifespans from decaying to zero. The conclusion is that the floor is not arbitrary but a grace-held minimum coupling sustaining human biology.
short_summary: This document is a statistical analysis of the Genesis 5 and 11 patriarchal lifespans. The core structural claim is that these lifespans follow an exponential decay curve with an asymptotic floor at ~93 years. Key evidence includes the curve fit (R² = 0.888), the model's independent discovery of the floor, and its convergence with Psalm 90:10 and modern life expectancy. This matters because it suggests the lifespan data is a measurable record of generational entropy and common grace, bridging theology and mathematical physics.
